opening.argument: The offer centers on purchasing packages containing tokens that can be exchanged for mining slots, with the speaker referring to payment and the cost of mining for coins. OneCoin is presented as a financial opportunity whose value will grow and whose participants can earn passive income by recommending others. The compensation structure includes a 10 percent bonus for personal introductions and matching bonuses through four generations of referrals, while participants are told they will profit even without recommending others. Viewers are urged to secure a position and directed to join the speaker's team. These are promises of package-linked mining returns and referral income, although the evidence does not establish actual payments, mining, profits, or participant outcomes.
